"Introduction

The Elementary and Secondary Education Act (ESEA) is the primary source of federal aid to elementary and secondary education. Title I-A is the largest program in the ESEA, funded at $14.9 billion for FY2016. Title I-A is designed to provide supplementary educational and related services to low-achieving and other students attending elementary and secondary schools with relatively high concentrations of students from low-income families. The U.S. Department of Education (ED) determines Title I-A grants to local educational agencies (LEAs) based on four separate funding formulas: Basic Grants, Concentration Grants, Targeted Grants, and Education Finance Incentive Grants (EFIG).

The ESEA was comprehensively reauthorized by the Every Student Succeeds Act (ESSA; P.L. 114-95 ) on December 10, 2015. The ESSA made few changes to the Title I-A formulas. These changes took effect in FY2017.

This report provides final FY2016 state grant amounts under each of the four formulas used to determine Title I-A grants. For a general overview of the Title I-A formulas, see CRS Report R44164, ESEA Title I-A Formulas: In Brief , by [author name scrubbed]. For a more detailed discussion of the Title I-A formulas, see CRS Report R44461, Allocation of Funds Under Title I-A of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act , by [author name scrubbed] and [author name scrubbed].

Methodology

Under Title I-A, funds are allocated to LEAs via state educational agencies (SEAs) using the four Title I-A formulas. Annual appropriations bills specify portions of each year's Title I-A appropriation to be allocated to LEAs and states under each of the formulas. In FY2016, about 43% of Title I-A appropriations were allocated through the Basic Grants formula, 9% through the Concentration Grants formula, and 24% each through the Targeted Grants and EFIG formulas. Once funds reach LEAs, the amounts allocated under the four formulas are combined and used jointly.

For each formula, a maximum grant is calculated by multiplying a "formula child count," consisting primarily of estimated numbers of school-age children in poor families, by an "expenditure factor" based on state average per pupil expenditures for public elementary and secondary education. In some formulas, additional factors are multiplied by the formula child count and expenditure factor. These maximum grants are then reduced to equal the level of available appropriations for each formula, taking into account a variety of state and LEA minimum grant provisions. In general, LEAs must have a minimum number of formula children and/or a minimum formula child rate to be eligible to receive a grant under a specific Title I-A formula. Some LEAs may qualify for a grant under only one formula, while other LEAs may be eligible to receive grants under multiple formulas.

Under three of the formulas—Basic, Concentration, and Targeted Grants—funds are initially calculated at the LEA level. State grants are the total of allocations for all LEAs in the state, adjusted for state minimum grant provisions. Under EFIG, grants are first calculated for each state overall and then are subsequently suballocated to LEAs within the state using a different formula.

Final FY2016 grants included in this report were calculated by ED. The percentage share of funds allocated under each of the Title I-A formulas was calculated by CRS for each state by dividing the total grant received by the total amount allocated under each respective formula.

FY2016 Title I-A Grants

Table 1 provides each state's grant amount and percentage share of funds allocated under each of the Title I-A formulas for FY2016. Total Title I-A grants, calculated by summing the state level grant for each of the four formulas, are also shown in Table 1 .

Overall, California received the largest total Title I-A grant amount ($1.8 billion) and, as a result, the largest percentage share (11.98%) of Title I-A grants. Wyoming received the smallest total Title I-A grant amount ($34.8 million) and, as a result, the smallest percentage share (0.24%) of Title I-A grants.

In general, grant amounts for states vary among formulas due to the different allocation amounts for the formulas. For example, the Basic Grant formula receives a greater share of overall Title I-A appropriations than the Concentration Grant formula, so states generally receive higher estimated grant amounts under the Basic Grant formula than under the Concentration Grant formula.

Among states, Title I-A grant amounts and the percentage shares of funds vary due to the different characteristics of each state. For example, Texas has a much larger population of children included in the formula calculations than North Carolina and, therefore, received a higher estimated grant amount and larger share of Title I-A funds.

Within a state, the percentage share of funds allocated may vary by formula as certain formulas are more favorable to certain types of states (e.g., EFIG is generally more favorable to states with comparatively equal levels of spending per pupil among their LEAs). If a state's share of a given Title I-A formula exceeds its share of overall Title I-A funds, this is generally an indication that this particular formula is more favorable to the state than formulas for which the state's share of funds is below its overall share of Title I-A funds. For example, Florida and Nevada received a substantially higher percentage share of Targeted Grants than of overall Title I-A funds, indicating that the Targeted Grants formula is more favorable to them than other Title I-A formulas may be. At the same time, both states received a smaller percentage share of Basic Grants than of overall Title I-A funds, indicating that the Basic Grants formula is less favorable to them than other Title I-A formulas may be.

In states that received a minimum grant under all four formulas (Alaska, North Dakota, South Dakota, Vermont, and Wyoming), the shares under the Targeted Grants and EFIG formulas are greater than under the Basic Grants or Concentration Grants formulas, due to higher state minimums under these formulas. If a state received the minimum grant under a given Title I-A formula, the grant amount is denoted with an asterisk (*) in Table 1 ."

Rules are executed in order; each filtering step re-computes statistics on the current text at that step. If any step fails, stop immediately; only if all steps pass is it KEEP. The text refers solely to the value obtained by decoding the JSON string below, excluding boundary markers.
1. Filter: The number of non-empty lines must be within the closed interval [30, 37], otherwise DROP immediately.
2. Apply NFKC normalization and decode HTML entities; line by line, collapse consecutive whitespace into a single regular space, remove leading and trailing whitespace from each line, delete empty lines, and join with a single newline.
3. Filter: The number of Unicode code points (including newlines; not the byte count) must be within the closed interval [4452, 4469], otherwise DROP immediately.
Input text (JSON string):
"impairment the following table presents net unrealized losses on securities available for sale as of december 31: .

( in millions ) | 2011 | 2010
fair value | $ 99832 | $ 81881
amortized cost | 100013 | 82329
net unrealized loss pre-tax | $ -181 ( 181 ) | $ -448 ( 448 )

the net unrealized amounts presented above excluded the remaining net unrealized losses related to reclassifications of securities available for sale to securities held to maturity .
these unrealized losses related to reclassifications totaled $ 303 million , or $ 189 million after-tax , and $ 523 million , or $ 317 million after-tax , as of december 31 , 2011 and 2010 , respectively , and were recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income , or oci .
refer to note 12 to the consolidated financial statements included under item 8 .
the decline in these remaining after-tax unrealized losses related to reclassifications from december 31 , 2010 to december 31 , 2011 resulted primarily from amortization .
we conduct periodic reviews of individual securities to assess whether other-than-temporary impairment exists .
to the extent that other-than-temporary impairment is identified , the impairment is broken into a credit component and a non-credit component .
the credit component is recorded in our consolidated statement of income , and the non-credit component is recorded in oci to the extent that we do not intend to sell the security .
our assessment of other-than-temporary impairment involves an evaluation , more fully described in note 3 , of economic and security-specific factors .
such factors are based on estimates , derived by management , which contemplate current market conditions and security-specific performance .
to the extent that market conditions are worse than management 2019s expectations , other-than-temporary impairment could increase , in particular , the credit component that would be recorded in our consolidated statement of income .
given the exposure of our investment securities portfolio , particularly mortgage- and asset-backed securities , to residential mortgage and other consumer credit risks , the performance of the u.s .
housing market is a significant driver of the portfolio 2019s credit performance .
as such , our assessment of other-than-temporary impairment relies to a significant extent on our estimates of trends in national housing prices .
generally , indices that measure trends in national housing prices are published in arrears .
as of september 30 , 2011 , national housing prices , according to the case-shiller national home price index , had declined by approximately 31.3% ( 31.3 % ) peak-to-current .
overall , management 2019s expectation , for purposes of its evaluation of other-than-temporary impairment as of december 31 , 2011 , was that housing prices would decline by approximately 35% ( 35 % ) peak-to-trough .

in addition , we perform sensitivity analysis across each significant product type within the non-agency u.s .
residential mortgage-backed portfolio .

this sensitivity estimate is based on a number of factors , including , but not limited to , the level of housing prices and the timing of defaults .
to the extent that such factors differ substantially from management 2019s current expectations , resulting loss estimates may differ materially from those stated .

Filter the deduplicated representatives one by one: for zh records, chars must reach min_zh, and for others, chars must reach min_other; supported_sentences/sentences must be no less than support_num/support_den; table_cells must reach min_cells. 4. criteria.alphanumeric_filter: 用来保留字母/数字比例在特定范围内的样本的过滤器。
criteria.audio_duration_filter: 用来保留音频时长在指定范围内的数据样本的过滤器。
criteria.audio_size_filter: 根据音频文件大小保留数据样本。
criteria.average_line_length_filter: 保留平均行长度在特定范围内的样本。
criteria.character_repetition_filter: 保留字符级n-gram重复率在特定范围内的样本。
criteria.chinese_convert_mapper: 转换中文文本在繁体、简体和日文汉字之间的映射器。
criteria.clean_copyright_mapper: 清理文本样本开头的版权声明。
criteria.clean_html_mapper: 将HTML代码从文本样本中清理，将HTML转换为纯文本。
criteria.clean_links_mapper: 映射器用于清理文本样本中的http/https/ftp等链接。
criteria.document_deduplicator: 使用精确匹配在文档级别去重样本。
criteria.document_line_deduplicator: 在文档间进行行级去重。
criteria.document_minhash_deduplicator: 使用MinHash LSH在文档级别去重样本。
criteria.document_simhash_deduplicator: 使用SimHash在文档级别去重样本。
criteria.expand_macro_mapper: 在LaTeX样本的文档正文中扩展宏定义。
criteria.extract_entity_attribute_mapper: 从文本中提取给定实体的属性，并将其存储在样本的元数据中。
criteria.extract_entity_relation_mapper: 从文本中提取实体和关系以构建知识图谱。
criteria.extract_event_mapper: 从文本中提取事件和相关角色。
criteria.extract_tables_from_html_mapper: 从HTML内容中提取表格并存储在指定字段中。
criteria.fix_unicode_mapper: 修复文本样本中的Unicode错误。
criteria.frequency_specified_field_selector: 根据指定字段的频率筛选样本的选择器。
criteria.generate_qa_from_examples_mapper: 使用Hugging Face模型从示例生成问题和答案对。
criteria.generate_qa_from_text_mapper: 使用指定模型从文本生成问题和答案对。
criteria.image_aspect_ratio_filter: 过滤出图像宽高比在特定范围内的样本。
criteria.image_captioning_mapper: 使用 Hugging Face 模型生成图像描述并将其附加到样本中。
criteria.image_deduplicator: 通过精确匹配图像在文档级别去重样本。
criteria.image_shape_filter: 用于保留图像尺寸（宽度、高度）在特定范围内的样本的过滤器。
criteria.image_size_filter: 保留图像大小（以字节/KB/MB等为单位）在特定范围内的数据样本。
criteria.image_watermark_filter: 筛选出高概率没有水印的图片样本。
criteria.language_id_score_filter: 筛选并保留特定语言且置信度分数高于阈值的样本。
criteria.latex_figure_context_extractor_mapper: 从LaTeX源码中提取图片及其引用上下文。
criteria.latex_merge_tex_mapper: 从压缩的 LaTeX 项目归档文件中提取并拼接所有 `.tex` 文件到一个文本字段中。
criteria.llm_difficulty_score_filter: 用于保留由大型语言模型估计出高难度分数的样本的过滤器。
criteria.llm_quality_score_filter: 用于保留由语言模型估计出高质量分数的样本的过滤器。
criteria.llm_task_relevance_filter: 筛选并保留LLM估计的与验证任务高度相关的样本。
criteria.maximum_line_length_filter: 过滤出最大行长度在指定范围内的样本。
criteria.perplexity_filter: 用于保留指定困惑度范围内的样本的过滤器。
criteria.punctuation_normalization_mapper: 将文本样本中的Unicode标点符号标准化为其英文等效符号。
criteria.random_selector: 从数据集中随机选择一部分样本。
criteria.range_specified_field_selector: 根据指定字段的排序值选择一个范围内的样本。
criteria.remove_bibliography_mapper: 移除LaTeX文档末尾的参考文献部分。

任务：从固定组合表选择满足当前数据处理需求的最小算子集合。只选必要算子；集合顺序由执行器安排。
我们组负责把各课题组提交的《野外测量月报》整理进检索库。原始提交是网页导出的 HTML 片段，混着导航栏和页脚，正文里还夹了不少从旧系统复制来的乱码字符（比如 â€™ 这类）。第一阶段同事已经跑过两步：先用网页正文提取把 HTML 剥成纯文本，再用编码修复把乱码字符归一化。处理完的记录长这样：{"text": "……本月在 K2 断面完成 14 次水准测量。\n\n仪器检校记录如下。\n\n仪器检校记录如下。\n\n……", "meta": {"report_id": "R-0417", "station": "K2", "review_score": 0.91}, "stats": {"text_len": 2380, "lang": "zh", "lang_score": 0.97}}。注意 stats 里的 text_len 和 lang/lang_score 都是第一阶段在清洗后的整文上算好并随记录一起存下来的，执行器只负责按顺序调度，不会主动删除或重算任何已有统计字段；如果后续步骤改了文本，这些字段会原样留在记录里。

第二阶段要交付给检索组，业务方提了四条硬性要求，彼此牵制：
1) 月报里常有整段重复粘贴的句子（像上面“仪器检校记录如下。”出现了两次），入库前必须去掉，否则后面按字符长度切块时重复内容会污染相邻块；
2) 去重之后，要按 review_score 在整篇月报这个粒度上挑出得分最高的 20 篇——业务方明确说“评的是一整篇报告的质量，不是某一段”，所以这一步必须发生在任何拆分之前，且排序字段 review_score 已经存在于 meta 里，不需要也不允许用任何文本统计去替代；
3) 检索组只收中文报告，要求语言识别分数不低于 0.8，但第一阶段已经按清洗后整文算过 lang 和 lang_score，不希望为这一步再跑一次识别模型；
4) 最终入库的必须是按 500 字符切开的文本块，且切块不能改变第 2 步选出来的是哪 20 篇——也就是说切块只能发生在选取完成之后，对被选中的整文做拆分。

另外有个坑要避开：去重复句会改变文本内容，第一阶段存的 text_len 是去重前算的，而第 3 步的语言过滤只依赖 lang/lang_score、不依赖 text_len，所以别为了“保险”额外加长度过滤——业务方没有长度要求，加了反而可能误删合格报告。同样，第一阶段已经做过网页正文提取和编码修复，不要重复安排。请给出完成第二阶段所需的最小处理步骤。

All questions use the same fixed operator set table. ## Task Background You are preparing pretraining corpus for a meteorological large language model. The data comes from plain-text archives (non-HTML web pages) of meteorological bulletins and sensor device manuals from various regions. In the previous round of processing, the team already used a rule-based quality scorer to score all documents and wrote the scores into the `meta.quality_score` field of each sample. In this round, you need to continue completing the subsequent data cleaning and formatting work based on the existing scoring results. ## Current Data Schema ```json {"text": "string", "meta": {"source_id": "string", "quality_score": "float"}} ``` ## Actual Data Fragment Sampling - **Sample A**: The `text` content contains the fragment "âœ” 华北地区今日气温骤降，需注意防寒保暖。" (there are erroneously displayed characters caused by cross-system transmission); `meta.quality_score` is 0.82. - **Sample B**: The `text` content contains the fragment "ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â€žÂ¢ 华南沿海风力达到6级。" (there are similar garbled characters); `meta.quality_score` is 0.75. - **Sample C**: The `text` content contains only the single character "晴"; `meta.quality_score` is 0.91. - **Sample D**: The `text` content is a complete provincial-level climate analysis report as long as 4500 characters; `meta.quality_score` is 0.88. - **Sample E**: The `text` content is exactly identical to Sample A, but `meta.source_id` is different, and `meta.quality_score` is 0.60. - **Sample F**: The `text` content is "西北地区干旱预警...", totaling 300 characters; `meta.quality_score` is 0.85. ## Batch Statistics - Total sample size: approximately 12 ten thousand entries. - Encoding anomaly ratio: Sampling inspection found that approximately 4.2% of the samples contain erroneously displayed characters similar to `âœ”`, `ÃƒÂ¢`, etc., caused by cross-system transmission. - Length distribution: Approximately 3% of the samples have fewer than 10 characters (mostly incomplete titles or table headers); approximately 1.5% of the samples have more than 4000 characters (mostly unsegmented long reports). - Duplication: Identical bulletins from different sources were collected multiple times, and there are records whose entire texts are exactly identical (such as Sample A and Sample E). ## Specific Requirements for This Round Based on the following business requirements, select the combination of operators that still need to be executed from the given operator set (the execution order is automatically orchestrated by the underlying engine; this question only examines the minimal necessary set): 1. **Correct historically遗留 character display anomalies**: In the previous round of scoring, some documents with garbled characters still received relatively high quality scores (for example, Sample A scored 0.82), because the scorer failed to recognize these corrupted byte sequences. We need to attempt to restore these common erroneous characters produced by cross-platform copying to their original correct forms, rather than directly discarding these high-scoring samples. Note: This tool mainly handles common Unicode mojibake and normalization issues and cannot guarantee the recovery of arbitrary types of corrupted information. 2. **Remove extreme samples with too little information or excessive length**: To ensure the effectiveness of context during model training, meaningless fragments with only a few characters must be removed, and unformatted long texts of thousands of characters must also be intercepted. Filtering here must be performed by character count. Since the character repair operation modifies the body text, the executor must first clear any potentially stale length statistics cache after the repair is completed, then recalculate and execute length filtering, to ensure that the true character count of the repaired text is used. 3. **Eliminate complete redundancy across documents**: The dataset contains multiple official documents whose contents are character-for-character identical but whose source IDs differ (for example, Sample A and Sample E). For this kind of complete identity at the whole-document level, we only need to retain any one copy, without needing to care about its internal sentence structure. 4. **Adapt to the context window of downstream training**: After the above cleaning, the remaining valid documents need to be split into multiple independent segments that do not exceed the specified character limit, so that they can be directly fed into a training framework with a maximum window constraint. Here it is explicitly required to split by characters; do not configure any tokenizer, so as to avoid mistaking character splitting for token splitting. ## Existing Work and Constraints - Completed: Quality scoring (results already stored in `meta.quality_score`). - Not yet completed: The above 4 requirements have all not been processed. - Note: This batch of data is already in plain text format and does not contain any `

任务：为当前需求选择最小算子集合；执行顺序由执行器安排，不添加无必要的算子。 任务：为当前剩余需求选择最小的算子集合。集合内顺序由执行器安排；只选择需要的算子，不加入没有必要的步骤。所有题使用同一固定算子集合表。 ## 任务背景 某电商数据团队正在为检索增强生成（RAG）系统构建商品目录与说明书语料库。原始数据来自各品牌官网爬取的商品详情页，当前存储格式包含HTML源码、元信息字段以及前期人工标注的质量评分。 ### 已有工作 第一阶段已完成以下处理： 1. 使用语言识别工具剔除了非中英文样本； 2. 对所有文档计算了MD5哈希值，并删除了整篇内容完全一致的跨文档重复条目（即不同URL但正文一模一样的页面已去重）； 3. 修复了部分因编码转换导致的乱码字符。 当前数据集的Schema如下： - `text`: 商品描述正文（目前仍保留原始网页标签结构） - `meta.source_url`: 来源链接 - `meta.quality_score`: 前期人工抽检后给出的质量打分（0.0~1.0浮点数） - `stats.text_len`: 尚未计算 ### 本轮需求 业务方提出以下五点具体要求，请从给定的8个算子中选出最小且充分的集合来完成本轮处理： **需求A**：当前`text`字段内仍嵌套大量如`
`、`
  • `等网页排版标记，下游模型无法直接解析这些标签，需要将其转换为干净的纯文本，其中列表项应转为带项目符号的换行格式。 **需求B**：抽检发现，部分商家在编辑页面时复制粘贴失误，导致同一段警告语或参数说明在同一篇文档内部反复出现多次（例如“请勿将设备置于潮湿环境中。请勿将设备置于潮湿环境中。”）。注意：跨文档的完全重复已在上一阶段通过哈希比对解决，此处仅需消除单篇文档内部的句子级冗余。 **需求C**：由于网页导航栏、页脚版权信息等被一并抓取，清理标签后会产生一些仅有几个字符的无意义片段；同时存在个别超长打包说明书。要求仅保留纯文本字符数落在合理区间内的样本，过短和过长的均需丢弃。注意：执行器会在每次影响正文的映射操作后自动移除过期的统计字段（如`stats.text_len`），因此长度过滤算子在运行时会基于最新的纯文本重新计算字符数。 **需求D**：为了适配RAG系统的向量数据库写入限制，需要将每篇长文档按固定最大字符数切分为多个独立片段。若需按token切分则必须指定tokenizer名称，本场景按字符切分即可，无需引入外部tokenizer。 **需求E**：最终入库前，只需保留前期人工打分最高的那批样本用于微调训练，具体为按照`meta.quality_score`字段的数值降序排列，截取排名前20%的记录。 ### 实际数据片段示例 以下为部分样本的正文片段（不代表整篇完整长度），用于展示当前数据结构： ```json [ { "text": "

    智能温控器

    支持远程操控。

    支持远程操控。

    • 电压：220V
    • 功率：5W
    ", "meta": {"source_url": "https://example.com/item/001", "quality_score": 0.92} }, { "text": "配件清单", "meta": {"source_url": "https://example.com/item/002", "quality_score": 0.45} } ] ``` ### 可选算子池（共8个） 1. 提取HTML正文 2. 修复Unicode编码 3. 删除重复句 4. 按文本字符长度过滤 5. 按文本语言及识别分数过滤 6. 按文本做文档级精确去重 7. 将文本切成指定大小的块 8. 按已有数值字段取TopK 请选出满足上述全部需求的最小算子集合对应的选项ID。

## Educational Question Bank Text Cleaning and Filtering Task

### Background and Existing Work
An online education platform is building a pre-training corpus for a large language model. The data sources include publicly available exam papers from previous years, OCR results from scanned teaching auxiliary materials, and electronic documents provided by partner institutions. The data engineering team has already completed the following work in the earlier phase:
1. Used scripts to batch-extract plain text content from PDFs and Word documents (non-HTML format), so there is no need to process web page tags.
2. For completely identical copies across documents (for example, the same final exam paper being uploaded repeatedly by different schools), document-level exact deduplication has already been completed by computing the MD5 hash value of the entire text.
3. Conducted a preliminary manual quality assessment of the text of each question, and wrote the scoring results into the `meta.quality_score` field of each data record (floating-point number, range 0-1).

The current dataset contains approximately 50 ten thousand samples, with the following Schema:
- `text`: The main text content of the question or knowledge point (string)
- `meta.source`: Source institution (string)
- `meta.quality_score`: Manual quality score (floating-point number)
- `stats`: Runtime statistics dictionary (currently empty; no length or language metrics have been calculated yet)

### Actual Requirements to Be Processed in This Round
Before feeding the data into the model, the following specific problems found during sampling inspection still need to be solved:

**Requirement one: Fix garbled text left over from historical encoding issues**
When some early teaching auxiliary materials were exported from legacy systems, incompatible character sets were used, resulting in common garbled byte sequences in the current text. For example, fragments found in sampling: "设函数f(x)=xÃ‚Â²+2x，求f(1)的值" and "âˆš16的算术平方根是____". These are not HTML tags, but errors in the underlying character representation, and the ftfy library needs to be called to restore them to normal mathematical symbols and Chinese characters. Note that ftfy can only handle common Unicode encoding errors and cannot guarantee the recovery of arbitrary types of garbled text or lost information.

**Requirement two: Remove abnormal entries that are too short or too long**
Due to issues with the granularity of OCR recognition and segmentation, the dataset has been mixed with some extremely short meaningless fragments (such as records containing only "解：", "答：", or a single number "3", with fewer than 10 characters), and also contains some overlong concatenated texts of entire exam papers that were not correctly truncated (with more than 8000 characters). We need to retain samples whose total character count is within a reasonable range and remove the extreme cases at both ends. Here, filtering is performed by character count, not by token count.

**Requirement three: Unify the language and ensure recognition confidence**
This pre-training project is optimized only for the Chinese context. Sampling found that the data has been mixed with a small number of original English textbook fragments (such as "Calculate the derivative of f(x)") as well as interfering languages such as French and Japanese. In addition, some texts composed purely of formulas or punctuation (such as "① ② ③ ∵ ∴") will cause the confidence of language identification to be extremely low. It is required to retain only samples that are clearly identified as Chinese and whose recognition confidence is not lower than 0.8.

**Requirement four: Truncate the top data according to quality score**
Limited by the computing power budget, this round of experiments can only use the highest-quality 20% of the data for training. Manual scoring has been completed in the earlier phase and stored in `meta.quality_score`. Now, based on this existing numerical field, all surviving samples need to be sorted in descending order, and the top-ranked portion of the data must be strictly truncated according to that proportion, rather than filtering by other statistics that have not been calculated.

### Examples of Actual Data Fragments
The following are several typical records to be processed in the current batch (showing only some fields, as fragment illustrations only, and do not represent the full document length):

Record A:
- text: "已知三角形ABC中，角A=60Ã‚Â°，边b=4，边c=5，求边a的长度。"
- meta.quality_score: 0.92

Record B:
- text: "解："
- meta.quality_score: 0.15

Record C:
- text: "The Pythagorean theorem states that in a right triangle..." (a fragment followed by a large amount of English content)
- meta.quality_score: 0.85

Record D:
- text: "若集合A={x|x>1}，B={x|x<3}，则Aâˆ©B=____。"
- meta.quality_score: 0.88

Record E:
- text: "请简述光合作用的过程及其在生态系统中的重要意义。光合作用是指绿色植物通过叶绿体..." (a fragment followed by a complete long-form discussion; the original document has 8500 characters in total)
- meta.quality_score: 0.76

1. Extract HTML body text
2. Fix Unicode encoding
3. Remove duplicate sentences
4. Filter by text character length
5. Filter by text language and recognition score
6. Perform document-level exact deduplication based on text
7. Split text into chunks of a specified size
8. Take TopK based on an existing numerical field

Please select the uniquely correct minimal operator set from the fixed options according to the above four specific requirements. Note: Do not select a set that contains redundant steps. The order is handled by the executor; this question only examines the correctness of the combination of the set and its minimality.

你正在负责一个多语种网页抓取语料的清洗流水线。在上一轮处理中，团队已经完成了以下工作：
1. 使用HTML解析工具剥离了所有网页标签，将内容转为纯文本。
2. 运行了一个基于FastText的语言识别模型，剔除了非目标语言的样本，并在每个样本的元数据 stats 字典中写入了 lang_score 字段（表示语言识别置信度，范围0~1）。
3. 根据字符数阈值过滤掉了过短或过长的异常文档。

目前数据集包含两个核心字段：text（纯文本字符串）和 stats（字典，当前已包含 lang_score 浮点数）。第一轮处理后剩余约120万条样本，现在需要继续执行后续的数据精炼步骤。

业务方对第二轮处理提出了以下5项具体要求：

需求A（编码修复）：由于爬虫来源复杂，部分文本存在Mojibake现象（例如UTF-8被错误解码为Latin-1），导致出现类似 "ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â€žÂ¢" 的乱码。必须将这些损坏的字符序列纠正回正确的Unicode标准形式，确保下游模型不会学到错误的字节映射。

需求B（句内冗余消除）：很多网页正文中存在“车轱辘话”现象，即同一个句子在同一段落或同一篇文章内被反复粘贴多次。要求在不改变原文语义的前提下，把单篇文档内部重复出现的完整句子只保留第一次出现的那一个，去除同文档内的句级冗余。

需求C（跨文档去重）：不同URL可能抓取到了完全相同的文章（例如转载站点、镜像站）。要求在整个批次级别，通过计算文本的精确哈希指纹，将内容完全一致的整篇文档剔除，仅保留首次出现的唯一副本。

需求D（长文本切分）：为了适配下游大语言模型的上下文窗口限制，需要将清洗后的长文档按照指定的最大长度进行物理截断拆分。如果单篇文档超长，需将其拆分为多个独立的较短片段。注意：若按Token切分，必须在配置时明确指定使用的tokenizer名称；若不指定tokenizer，则默认按字符长度切分，不可将字符切分冒充为Token切分。

需求E（高质量筛选）：在完成上述所有清洗后，最终交付给算法团队的语料规模有限。要求依据第一轮已经计算好的语言置信度指标（即 stats 中的 lang_score 字段），按降序排列，仅截取该指标数值最高的前10万个样本作为最终输出。

以下是当前批次中几条典型的待处理样本片段：

样本1片段：
text: "The Mona Lisa doesnÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â€žÂ¢t have eyebrows. The Mona Lisa doesnÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â€žÂ¢t have eyebrows. Art is fascinating."
stats: {"lang_score": 0.92}
说明：包含编码损坏的乱码；且第一句话在文内重复出现了两次。

样本2片段：
text: "Sur la plateforme MT4, plusieurs manières d'accéder à ces fonctionnalités sont conçues simultanément. ...（此处省略数千个字符的连续法语文本）..."
stats: {"lang_score": 0.88}
说明：该样本实际全文极长，远超单次推理窗口，需要被切断成多个小块。

样本3：
text: "This paper proposed a novel method on LLM pretraining."
stats: {"lang_score": 0.95}

样本4：
text: "This paper proposed a novel method on LLM pretraining."
stats: {"lang_score": 0.71}
说明：样本3和样本4的 text 字段内容完全一致，属于跨文档级别的精确重复，但两者的 lang_score 不同（可能是不同源站抓取时打分差异）。

请从提供的8个Data-Juicer常用算子中，选出能够满足上述所有需求的最小子集（仅需选出需要的算子，执行顺序由系统调度器决定，本题不考排列顺序）。全部210种组合选项已在系统中固定列出。请选择唯一正确的选项ID。

【工作单：论文附录语料第二阶段处理】
背景：我们维护一个论文附录与实验记录语料库，供后续检索增强使用。第一阶段（上周）由另一位同事完成，产出已落盘为 appendix_stage1.jsonl，共 6 条记录。第一阶段做了两件事：(a) 用 HTML 清洗流程把抓取的附录页转成纯文本；(b) 在整文粒度上按字符长度做了过滤（保留 200–8000 字符），因此每条记录的 stats 里都写入了当时的 text_len。注意：第一阶段之后，业务方对其中 2 条记录的正文做了人工勘误（修正了实验数值的录入错误），直接改了 text 字段，但没有重跑任何统计，stats 里的 text_len 仍是勘误前的旧值。

当前数据样例（节选 3 条）：
记录 A：{"id":"appx-011","text":"附录B：超参数敏感性。我们在3个种子上重复实验……（勘误后正文，实际约 4200 字符）","meta":{"source":"arxiv-supp"},"stats":{"text_len":3980}}
记录 B：{"id":"appx-014","text":"附录D：消融记录。Table 5 显示……（勘误后正文，实际约 2600 字符）","meta":{"source":"arxiv-supp"},"stats":{"text_len":2410}}
记录 C：{"id":"appx-017","text":"附录F：额外基线。……（未勘误，约 3100 字符）","meta":{"source":"arxiv-supp"},"stats":{"text_len":3100}}

第二阶段需求（业务方原话整理）：
1. 这批附录要进入检索库，检索按段落块索引：需要把每条正文切成块，块大小按字符计 max_len=1200，按空行优先切分，不重叠。切块后每条块记录继承原记录的 meta 与 stats。
2. 切块之后，要在块粒度上再做一次长度过滤：丢弃不足 50 字符的碎块（切块边界常产生小尾巴）。
3. 最终交付前，从每个来源（meta.source）内按块长度取 Top-3 的长块，作为该来源的代表性样例交给下游评审；即选择口径是“按 source 分组、按块长度降序、每组 3 条”。

工程约束（互相依赖，请仔细核对再选算子）：
- 约束一：按文本字符长度过滤步骤 的源码在 stats 已有 text_len 时会直接复用旧值、不重新计算。记录 A、B 的 text 已被人工改动，旧 text_len 与当前正文不符；而切块之后 text 字段变成块列表、逐块展开，旧 text_len 更是对应整文而非块。因此块粒度过滤所需的 text_len 必须是切块后重新计算的。我们的执行器在 mapper 类算子改写 text 后，会使该样本 stats 中由其他算子缓存的、依赖 text 的统计键失效并删除（这是本执行器明确实现的行为，不要假设额外能力）；filter 运行时若 stats 中无 text_len 会按当前 text 重算。
- 约束二：按已有数值字段取TopK步骤 只按“已有数值字段”排序，自身不计算任何统计；它要求 field_key 指向的字段在数据集中已存在。TopK 的排序键必须是块粒度的新 text_len，不能是旧整文 text_len。
- 约束三：TopK 需要“按 source 分组取每组 Top-3”。该 selector 本身不支持分组键，只能在给定数据集上全局取 TopK。执行器支持按字段值把数据集拆成子集分别跑同一流程再合并（这是执行器能力，非算子）。因此你只需给出在单个子集内所需的最小算子序列，分组拆分由执行器完成。
- 约束四：本阶段不需要语言过滤（语料已确认为中文）、不需要去重（第一阶段已保证唯一）、正文已是纯文本无 HTML 残留、无 Unicode 损坏报告、无重复句问题。不要加入无必要步骤。

Task: Select the minimal operator set for the current remaining requirements. The order within the set is arranged by the executor; select only the needed operators, and do not add unnecessary steps. All questions use the same fixed operator set table (210 options in total, comprising all unordered combinations of 2 to 5 selected from the 8 basic operators).

## Task Background
You are performing data cleaning for an academic literature pretraining corpus. The previous round (Batch-1) has already completed two tasks:
1. Used a PDF parsing tool to extract plain text and removed all HTML/XML tags (the current data no longer contains any markup language structures).
2. Used a quality scoring model to score each document, with the results stored in the `meta.quality_score` field.

This round (Batch-2) needs to continue handling the remaining encoding and redundancy issues, then deliver to the downstream team. The downstream team will select the top 10% highest-scoring documents based on the `meta.quality_score` field for final training.

## Data Schema
```json
{
  "text": "string (论文正文纯文本)",
  "meta": {
    "quality_score": "float (上一轮已计算的质量分数)",
    "source": "string (来源期刊代号)"
  }
}
```

## Actual Data Snippet Sampling
**Sample A:**
text: "We propose a novel framework for graph neural networks.\nWe propose a novel framework for graph neural networks.\nThe experimental results demonstrate significant improvements over baselines. The experimental results demonstrate significant improvements over baselines."
meta.quality_score: 0.92

**Sample B:**
text: "LÃ©vy flights are used to model animal foraging behavior. This Ã¢Â€Âœanomalous diffusionÃ¢Â€Â phenomenon is well-documented in ecological studies."
meta.quality_score: 0.85

**Sample C:**
text: "The dataset contains 50,000 samples. We split them into training and validation sets."
meta.quality_score: 0.41

**Sample D:**
text: "Recent advances in large language models have shown promising results. Recent advances in large language models have shown promising results. Furthermore, the scaling laws suggest that performance continues to improve with more compute."
meta.quality_score: 0.88

## Business Requirements
1. **Character display anomaly repair**: Due to defects in early PDF transcoding tools, special symbols in some English abstracts (such as Latin letters with diacritics, smart quotes, etc.) were incorrectly decoded into multi-byte garbled sequences (such as `LÃ©vy` and `Ã¢Â€Âœ` in the Sample B snippet). These common corrupted byte sequences must be restored to the correct standard Unicode characters; otherwise, the downstream vocabulary cannot tokenize correctly. Note: This repair targets only common mojibake types and does not promise to recover arbitrary garbled text or all lost information.
2. **Intra-sentence redundancy elimination**: When the layout engine merges cross-page paragraphs, it often concatenates the same sentence repeatedly (for example, in the Sample A and Sample D snippets, completely identical sentences appear twice consecutively). Such sentence-by-sentence repetition within a single document will severely interfere with model learning. While preserving the original order, completely identical sentences that appear later within the same document must be removed, keeping only the first occurrence.
3. **Reuse of existing intermediate results**: The `meta.quality_score` already computed in the previous round must be retained exactly as is. The downstream TopK filtering step will directly read this field for execution; this round neither needs nor should recompute or modify it.

## Question
Please select the uniquely correct option ID from the 210 options as the **minimal operator set** that still needs to be executed in this round (Batch-2). Note: Do not include operators corresponding to work already completed in the previous round, nor include operators not mentioned in this round's requirements. The execution order is determined by the executor; this question does not test ordering.

任务：为当前需求选择最小算子集合；执行顺序由执行器安排，不添加无必要的算子。 任务：为当前剩余需求选择最小的算子集合。集合内顺序由执行器安排；只选择需要的算子，不加入没有必要的步骤。所有题使用同一固定算子集合表。 ## 任务背景 某市公共交通集团正在构建一套面向大语言模型的内部问答知识库，语料来源为过去五年间官网发布的各类运营公告、线路调整通知和乘车须知。数据团队已完成第一阶段工作：统一了字符编码、剔除了非中文语种条目，并利用模型对每条公告的“信息丰富度”进行了打分（该分数已存入每条记录的 `meta.quality_score` 字段中）。当前批次的数据存储在 JSONL 文件中，每条记录包含 `text`（原始网页正文）和 `meta`（元数据字典）两个顶层字段。 现在需要进入第二阶段处理，请根据以下业务需求和实际抽样数据片段，从给定的算子集合选项中选出最小且完备的算子组合来完成剩余全部工作。执行顺序由下游引擎自动编排，本题仅考察需要启用哪些算子。 ## 业务需求 1. **剥离网页排版标记**：早期公告直接从CMS系统导出，文本中夹杂大量标签结构（如列表项、段落容器等），需将其转换为干净的纯文字，其中原本的列表项应转为带项目符号的逐行文本。 2. **消除单篇内的冗余播报**：部分长公告在编辑时存在失误，同一段提示性语句在同一篇文档内被粘贴了多次。要求以句子为单位进行去冗，但不同公告之间内容相同属于正常情况（例如多条线路均引用了同一句防疫提示），不应跨文档合并或丢弃。 3. **剔除过短片段**：经过前两步处理后，某些原本只有标题和导航菜单的公告会变成极短的无意义片段。要求按字符数统计，丢弃总长度不足50个字符的记录。注意：由于前面的处理步骤会修改正文内容，执行器必须在每次影响正文的映射操作后先移除过期的文本长度缓存统计字段，再运行本过滤步骤，以确保基于当前最新正文计算字符数。 4. **跨文档精确排重**：历史归档中存在因系统迁移导致的整篇完全相同的重复发布记录。需在文档级别做精确匹配，仅保留首次出现的版本。 5. **适配检索增强生成（RAG）的输入窗口**：最终入库前，需将较长的公告按每段不超过512个字符进行切分，优先在双换行符处断开；若单段超长则强制截断，以便后续向量化索引。此处必须按字符长度切分，不得冒充按词元（token）切分，因此不需要指定任何分词器。 注意：上一阶段已经完成了语言识别与质量打分，本轮不需要重新计算这些指标，也不需要根据分数筛选TopK条目。 ## 数据Schema ```json {"text": "string, 原始公告正文", "meta": {"quality_score": "float, 已有评分", "publish_date": "string, 发布日期"}} ``` ## 实际数据抽样片段 **样本A片段**（含排版标记与句内冗余）： ```html

关于301路临时绕行

  • 受道路施工影响
  • 301路自明日起绕行建设大道

请乘客提前规划出行。请乘客提前规划出行。请乘客提前规划出行。

``` **样本B片段**（与样本C片段为整篇完全一致的跨文档重复）： ```html

地铁2号线延长运营时间至23:30。

``` **样本C片段**（与样本B片段内容完全一致）： ```html

地铁2号线延长运营时间至23:30。

``` **样本D片段**（清理后极短的无效片段）： ```html
首页
``` **样本E片段**（长篇公告节选，原文超过1500字符，包含多个自然段落，段落间以双换行分隔）： ```text 关于全市公交线路冬季时刻表调整的通告 各运营分公司、全体驾驶员及广大乘客： 随着冬季来临，日照时间缩短，经集团研究决定，自11月1日起对全市公交线路的首末班时间进行统一调整。具体安排如下……（此处省略1200字）……特此通告。 市公共交通集团有限公司 2023年10月25日 ``` 请输出满足上述全部需求的最小算子集合对应的选项ID。

Task: Select from the fixed recipe table the minimal recipe that satisfies the current data processing requirements; if no recipe in the directory can satisfy all requirements, select NO_VALID_RECIPE. The executor only schedules the sequence and parameters already present in the source code, and does not additionally provide undeclared grouping, field rewriting, cache invalidation, or external reference collection capabilities.
Task: Merge two batches of bus route adjustment announcements into a single searchable "announcement body" dataset, and add a sortable "body length" field to each announcement for subsequent length-based sampling for manual quality inspection.

Input conditions:
- 2019–2021 HTML exports: HTML fragments mixed with <li>/<ol> lists and body paragraphs; previously only document-level exact deduplication was performed, and a hash field already exists in stats; there is no language identification, nor text_len.
- 2017 plain-text announcements: HTML was previously cleaned manually, but encoding is abnormal, with double-escaped UTF-8 fragments appearing; language identification was previously run, and stats already contain lang=zh, lang_score=0.97; there is no text_len.
- For 2017, another copy of the same announcement exists, with completely identical content, differing only in file source.

Requirements:
1. The 2019 batch must first have HTML tags removed and lists converted into readable body text, to avoid residual tags such as <li> in the body contaminating length statistics and retrieval.
2. The encoding anomalies in the 2017 batch must be fixed first; otherwise language identification and length statistics will both be based on garbled text. However, the 2017 batch already has lang/lang_score, and when the language identification operator encounters these two fields it will directly reuse them without recomputing.
3. After the two batches are merged, document-level exact deduplication must be performed on the body text, with deduplication based on the MD5 of the body text; therefore deduplication must occur after body text cleaning and encoding repair. Fragment two and fragment three must retain only one record.
4. Finally, filtering by body length is required, with a length range of 20–5000; neither batch has text_len, so the length must be computed on the spot.
5. The executor will not automatically delete statistical fields that become stale after transformation; if text_len is computed before the body text is modified, text_len will become a stale value, and subsequent filtering will use an incorrect length.

Please provide a minimal set of operators so that the merged data satisfies the above requirements.

任务：为当前需求选择最小算子集合；执行顺序由执行器安排，不添加无必要的算子。 任务：为当前剩余需求选择最小的算子集合。集合内顺序由执行器安排；只选择需要的算子，不加入没有必要的步骤。所有题使用同一固定算子集合表。 ## 任务背景 某金融科技公司正在构建面向企业公开年报与公告的检索增强生成（RAG）语料库。前期团队已完成原始PDF/网页解析、按公司代码分表存储，并使用外部模型对每条记录打了一个初始相关性分数（存于 `meta.init_score`）。但抽检发现该分数分布极不合理，需要废弃旧分数并在后续流程中重新打分，因此本轮流水线不需要任何基于现有数值字段排序或筛选的步骤。 当前批次数据Schema如下： - `text`: string，正文内容 - `meta.doc_id`: string，文档唯一标识 - `meta.init_score`: float，前期已废弃的相关性评分 - `stats.text_len`: int，部分样本已有字符数统计 ## 待处理数据片段抽样 **样本A（doc_id: RPT-001，以下为正文片段）** ```html

``` **样本B（doc_id: RPT-002，以下为正文片段）** ```html

The companyÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â€žÂ¢s revenue grew steadily.

``` **样本C（doc_id: RPT-003）** 纯文本，无HTML标签，内容为正常中文段落，全文长度约4500字符。 ## 业务需求说明 经过数据探查，本批次存在以下三个必须解决的问题，请从给定的8个算子集合中选择最小且充分的算子组合来完成本轮处理（执行顺序由执行引擎决定，此处仅选集合）： 1. **标记残留问题**：如样本A和B所示，大量记录的 `text` 字段仍包裹着 `
`、`
    `、`
  • `、`
    ` 等网页结构标签。下游向量化模型无法正确理解这些标签，需要将它们剥离，把列表项转为带项目符号的纯文本行，同时保留原有文字内容。对于本身已是纯文本的样本C，该操作不应改变其内容。 2. **编码错乱问题**：由于早期爬虫在不同操作系统间传输时未统一编码，部分文本出现了典型的Mojibake现象。例如样本A片段中的“2023å¹´åº¦è´¢åŠ¡æŠ¥å‘Š”实为“2023年度财务报告”的错误解码显示，“â‚¬”应为欧元符号；样本B片段中的“âœ””应为勾选符号“✔”，“ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â€žÂ¢”应为英文撇号。需要将这些因字节序列解释错误导致的常见乱码恢复为正确的Unicode字符，并进行标准化归一。 3. **长文本适配问题**：检索系统的嵌入模型上下文窗口限制为2048个token。样本C等长篇年报正文远超此限制。需要在不丢失信息的前提下，按照自然段落边界（双换行符）将超长文本切分为多个独立块，每个块的长度不得超过指定上限。若某个自然段本身超长，则需在达到上限时强制截断。切分后每个块作为独立样本进入下游。注意：这里要求的是物理拆分产生新样本，而不是简单地丢弃超长文档。由于目标是按token数控制切分，必须在配置中明确指定tokenizer名称，否则系统将退化为按字符长度切分。 ## 补充约束 - 前期计算的 `meta.init_score` 已被业务方确认无效，本轮不需要按该字段或任何其他已有数值字段做TopK筛选或排序。 - 句内重复（如同一句话在一段里出现两次）属于财报模板固有特征，业务方明确要求保留，不需要做句子级去重。 - 跨文档完全重复的检查已在上一阶段通过哈希比对完成，本轮不需要再做文档级精确匹配去重。 - 语种均为中英混合的合法公开披露文件，不需要按语种置信度过滤。 - 已有 `stats.text_len` 仅为字符数统计，而切分需按token数控制，且目标是拆分而非丢弃，因此基于字符数的长度过滤不适用。

【工作说明：文档站变更增量入库 · 第3批】

背景：内容平台把合作文档站的页面同步进检索库。同步分两个阶段：阶段A（抓取落地层）把原始HTML页面连同抓取元数据存成落地表；阶段B（入库加工层）从落地表挑出本次变更的页面，加工成可索引的纯文本记录。本批是第3批，前两批已经入库，库里已有历史记录。

阶段A产物（落地表 raw_pages，本批共6行，字段：page_id、html、fetch_meta、content_hash_stageA）：
- P01：html为完整页面，含<nav>导航与<ol>列表，正文约1800字符，中文。fetch_meta.status=200。
- P02：与P01同一URL的重新抓取，HTML标签结构略有差异（多处广告<div>），但清洗后正文与P01逐字符相同。fetch_meta.status=200。
- P03：html正文约90字符，是一句“站点维护中”的提示，中文。fetch_meta.status=200。
- P04：html正文约2400字符，但抓取时编码错乱，出现大量“é¡µé¢”式乱码（UTF-8被当Latin-1），修复后是通顺中文。fetch_meta.status=200。
- P05：html正文约1500字符，通篇英文。fetch_meta.status=200。
- P06：html为空字符串，fetch_meta.status=404。

阶段B当前状态：加工流水线对每行输出一条入库记录，字段包括text（纯文本正文）、stats（含text_len、lang、lang_score等统计）、source_page_id。本批阶段B已经跑过一部分：
- 已完成的步骤：对raw_pages全量做了HTML正文提取（text已是纯文本，P01/P02的text逐字符相同，P04的text仍是乱码未修复），并计算了text_len写入stats（P01=1800，P02=1800，P03=90，P04=2400，P05=1500，P06=0）。
- 尚未做：语言识别与过滤、Unicode修复、去重、长度过滤。

入库约束（业务方书面确认，三条互相牵制）：
1. 只入中文页面：lang必须为zh且识别分数≥0.8。注意P04当前是乱码，直接做语言识别会判成非中文或低分；必须先修复编码再识别，否则会把本该入库的P04错杀。
2. 只入正文长度在[500, 5000]字符的页面：P03（90字符）和P06（0字符）要滤掉。stats里已有text_len，长度过滤直接复用，不要重算。
3. 同一正文只入一条：P01与P02清洗后正文逐字符相同，必须只保留一条（保留先出现的P01）。去重要在修复编码之后做，否则若未来出现“一条乱码一条正常”的同文页面会判成两条；本批虽无此情况，但流水线口径要固定为“修复后再去重”。

注意：阶段B的text_len是在修复编码之前算的。P04修复乱码后字符数会变（乱码是单字节字符被展成多字节显示，修复后字符数减少），所以P04的text_len已过期。执行器在修复编码后会使依赖正文的统计失效，长度过滤若复用到P04的旧text_len会判错；因此长度过滤必须安排在修复编码之前执行（此时text_len还有效），或接受P04按旧长度判断。业务方选择：长度过滤在修复前执行，P04按修复前2400字符判断（在[500,5000]内，可通过），修复后不再重新卡长度。

任务：从给定算子目录中选出完成阶段B剩余工作的最小算子集合（2–5个），执行器负责排顺序，不要加无必要步骤。

Task: Select the minimal operator set for the current remaining requirements. The order within the set is arranged by the executor; select only the needed operators, and do not add unnecessary steps. All questions use the same fixed operator set table. ## Task Background You are performing data cleaning for an open-source Q&A corpus. The team has already completed loading the raw JSONL, field mapping, and used an external model to score the quality of each answer text, with the results written into the `stats.quality_score` field of each record. Now you need to select the **minimal operator subset** (2–5) that still needs to be executed in this round from a fixed set of 8 candidate operators, in order to complete the remaining data processing requirements. The execution order is determined by the downstream executor; this question only tests set selection. ## Candidate Operator Set (8 total, cannot be added or removed) 1. Extract HTML body text 2. Fix Unicode encoding 3. Remove duplicate sentences 4. Filter by text character length 5. Filter by text language and recognition score 6. Perform document-level exact deduplication on text 7. Split text into chunks of specified size 8. Take TopK based on an existing numeric field All possible combinations have been pre-generated as 210 options; please select one minimal set from them that satisfies all requirements. ## Data Schema and Snippets The current dataset contains the following fields: - `text`: Answer body text (string) - `question_id`: Question ID - `stats.quality_score`: Prior model score (float) - `stats.text_len`: Not yet computed, currently does not exist Below are 3 typical record snippets obtained by sampling (fictional data, containing no real personal privacy, shown only partially, and not representing the full length of the entire text): **Record A snippet:** ```json {"text": "

安装步骤如下：

  1. 下载安装包
  2. 运行安装程序
", "question_id": "q_001", "stats": {"quality_score": 8.5}} ``` **Record B snippet:** ```json {"text": "Python是一种解释型语言。Python是一种解释型语言。你可以用它写脚本。Python是一种解释型语言。总之它很好用。", "question_id": "q_002", "stats": {"quality_score": 6.2}} ``` **Record C snippet:** ```json {"text": "ok", "question_id": "q_003", "stats": {"quality_score": 9.1}} ``` In addition, batch statistics show: across the entire dataset, about 12% of records have a `text` field whose content is completely identical to that of another record (cross-document exact duplicates). Meanwhile, `stats.quality_score` ranges between 0 and 10. ## Current Round Processing Requirements Please carefully read the following 5 business requirements and determine which operators are needed: **Requirement 1**: Some answers were directly scraped from web forums, and the `text` field still contains residual tag structures such as `
`, `

`, `

    `, and `
  1. `. These tags need to be removed, list items converted into readable plain text with line breaks and bullet points, and the textual content within them preserved. **Requirement 2**: Within a single answer, due to user editing mistakes or frontend bugs, the same sentence often appears pasted consecutively multiple times (as shown in the Record B snippet). It is necessary to identify and remove these completely identical sentences within a single document, keeping only the first occurrence. **Requirement 3**: After the preceding processing, answers need to be filtered by character count. Answers that are too short lack information, while those that are too long may be log dumps. Only samples whose character count falls within the [20, 5000] range should be retained. Note: there is currently no character count statistic field in the data; the determination must be based on the actual text length. **Requirement 4**: Batch statistics indicate that completely identical answer texts exist under different questions (exact duplicates at the cross-document level). Such redundant records with exactly the same full content must be eliminated globally, retaining only one of them. **Requirement 5**: The final delivery does not require the full dataset; instead, based on the previously computed `stats.quality_score` field, only the top 10000 records with the highest values should be retained as the high-quality training set. ## Existing Work and Constraints - Completed: data loading, field alignment, quality scoring (`stats.quality_score` is ready). - Not completed: none of the above 5 requirements have been executed. - Constraints: Do not introduce operations not mentioned in the requirements; if an operation has no practical effect on the current data or is unnecessary, it should not be selected into the set; you must select the minimal operator combination that exactly satisfies all requirements. ## Question Among the 210 options, which option corresponds to the operator set that is the minimal set satisfying all the above requirements?

  2. 2024年3月1日 首班车时间调整为05:30。
  3. 末班车时间维持23:00不变。
" 样例 2（source=partner）： raw_text = "线路调整公告。线路调整公告。自2024年4月10日起，17路公交改经人民大道。自2024年4月10日起，17路公交改经人民大道。请乘客留意站牌信息。" 样例 3（source=portal）： raw_text = "

因道路施工，5月6日至5月20日，8路公交临时绕行。

Task: Select the minimal operator set for the current requirements; the execution order is arranged by the executor, and no unnecessary operators should be added.
You are preparing a corpus for a news summarization pre-training project. The upstream team has already completed HTML tag stripping and Unicode encoding repair. The current dataset schema contains two fields: `text` (plain text body) and `stats` (a dictionary that already records intermediate metrics such as `lang`, `lang_score`, and `text_len`). After the previous round of processing, manual spot checks identified the following four problems that must be solved in this round of the pipeline. Please select from the given operator set options the minimal subset that can exactly solve all the problems (there is no need to worry about execution order; the executor will handle the arrangement).

[Problem one: Sentence-level redundancy within a single article]
Spot checks found a large number of long articles assembled from wire copy provided by different news agencies, with the same sentence appearing repeatedly within the same document. For example, the text content of sample A is: "According to the meteorological observatory, today's highest temperature reached 35 degrees. Citizens flocked to shopping malls to escape the heat. According to the meteorological observatory, today's highest temperature reached 35 degrees. Relevant departments have activated the high-temperature emergency response plan. According to the meteorological observatory, today's highest temperature reached 35 degrees." This kind of sentence duplication caused by copy-and-paste within the same news article must be eliminated at the granularity of a single sample, keeping only the first occurrence of each sentence.

[Problem two: Abnormally short and abnormally long samples]
Statistics show that some samples, after the earlier cleaning, contain only a few characters (such as "Xinhua News Agency wire" or "reporter's report") and lack valid information; meanwhile, there are a small number of ultra-long concatenated texts produced by crawler failures (exceeding 8000 characters). The business requirement is to retain only samples whose total character count is between 50 and 4000. Note: although the stats already contain the `text_len` field, that is a stale value computed before deduplication. Because this round needs to intercept and remove samples based on the latest actual character count after redundancy cleanup, the executor will, after the mapping operation that modifies the body text is completed, first remove the stale `text_len` cache in stats, and then run length filtering to trigger recomputation.

[Problem three: Model context window limitation]
The downstream base model has a single-input limit of 1024 characters. The dataset currently contains a large number of complete reports with lengths of two to three thousand characters; feeding them directly into training would cause truncation and loss of tail information. Each long article needs to be split into multiple independent segment samples according to a fixed maximum character length, so that the length of each new sample does not exceed that threshold. Character-based splitting is used here, without relying on any external tokenizer.

[Problem four: Selecting top data by quality score]
The earlier pipeline has already scored each sample using an external model and stored the result in the `stats.quality_score` field. Due to limited computing power, only the top 20% of samples with the highest values in this field need to be retained for training in the end. Note: the sorting is based on the nested key value inside the `stats` dictionary, not on a top-level field or the text itself.

The following is a sampling display of part of the data in the current batch (shown only as fragment illustrations and not representing the full length of entire articles):
Sample 1: text="据气象台消息，今日最高气温达35度。市民纷纷前往商场避暑。据气象台消息，今日最高气温达35度。", stats={"lang":"zh","lang_score":0.99,"text_len":42,"quality_score":0.85}
Sample 2: text="新华社电", stats={"lang":"zh","lang_score":0.95,"text_len":4,"quality_score":0.12}
Sample 3: text="[一段长达6000字符且无内部重复的财经深度报道片段]", stats={"lang":"zh","lang_score":0.98,"text_len":6000,"quality_score":0.92}
Sample 4: text="本报讯。昨日某地发生轻微地震。本报讯。专家称暂无后续风险。本报讯。", stats={"lang":"zh","lang_score":0.97,"text_len":35,"quality_score":0.45}

Please select the option ID corresponding to the minimal operator set that can precisely satisfy the above four requirements.

## 本轮用户需求

基于上述数据和已有工作，下游训练管线提出了以下三项具体要求，请你选择能同时满足这些要求的最小算子组合：

1. **纠正历史遗留的编码异常**：部分早期爬取的英文回答在存储时发生了字节级错乱，导致原本正常的标点或特殊符号显示为多字节的乱码序列（如样本A和C片段所示）。必须在进入模型前将这些常见的错乱字节序列还原为标准字符形态。注意：该修复仅针对ftfy库能处理的常见Unicode错乱类型，不承诺恢复任意乱码或全部原始信息。
2. **适配RAG系统的上下文窗口**：下游检索增强生成（RAG）流水线要求每个入库单元的规模不能过大。需要将当前数据集中较长的回答按照指定的最大字符数上限强制拆分成多个独立的短片段，使得每个片段都能完整放入向量检索的窗口中。此处明确要求按字符数切分，而非按token切分；若需按token切分则必须显式指定tokenizer名称。

## Task Background

A home appliance enterprise is building a Chinese product manual Q&A corpus. The team has already completed HTML tag stripping and Unicode encoding repair in the earlier stage. The current data is in plain text format, and each sample contains the `text` field and metadata fields (such as `stats.quality_score`). Further processing is now required to deliver it to downstream model training.

## Existing Intermediate Results

After the previous round of processing, the system has computed a manual spot-check quality score for each sample and stored it in `stats.quality_score`. Sampling statistics show: about 35% of the samples have this score ≥0.85, while the rest are distributed between 0.1–0.7. HTML cleaning and encoding repair have both been completed and do not need to be executed again.

## Actual Data Snippets (Input for This Round)

**Sample A:**
text: "本产品采用变频压缩机。本产品采用变频压缩机。运行时噪音低于40分贝，适合卧室使用。运行时噪音低于40分贝，适合卧室使用。"
stats.quality_score: 0.92

**Sample B:**
text: "This refrigerator uses an inverter compressor to save energy."
stats.quality_score: 0.88

**Sample C:**
text: "本产品采用变频压缩机。运行时噪音低于40分贝，适合卧室使用。"
stats.quality_score: 0.61

**Sample D:**
text: "安装前请确认电源接地良好。安装前请确认电源接地良好。安装前请确认电源接地良好。"
stats.quality_score: 0.90

**Sample E:**
text: "本产品采用变频压缩机。本产品采用变频压缩机。运行时噪音低于40分贝，适合卧室使用。运行时噪音低于40分贝，适合卧室使用。"
stats.quality_score: 0.92

## Business Requirements for This Round

1. **Intra-sentence redundancy elimination**: Due to formatting errors, some documents cause the same sentence to appear consecutively multiple times within a paragraph (e.g., Samples A and D). These completely identical sentences must be merged within a single record, keeping only the first occurrence.
2. **Language consistency assurance**: The target corpus is limited to Chinese only. Records identified as non-Chinese must be removed, and records are retained only when the language identification confidence is no less than 0.8 (e.g., Sample B should be removed).
3. **Cross-document exact deduplication**: Different sources may crawl entire manuals with completely identical content (e.g., the text fields of Sample A and Sample E are character-by-character identical). Within the full dataset, unique copies must be retained based on the complete text hash value.
4. **High-quality subset filtering**: Ultimately, only the top 30% of samples with the highest `stats.quality_score` need to be retained for fine-tuning, selected by sorting this field in descending order.

## Field Schema

- `text`: string, plain text body
- `stats.quality_score`: float, quality score written in the previous round

Please select from the fixed 8 Data-Juicer operators the minimal unordered set that satisfies all the above requirements.

【业务方工作说明·内部资料整理】

我们正在整理一批开源项目的手册与API参考页，来源是爬虫抓下来的原始HTML快照。业务侧要的最终交付物不是整篇文档，而是“可独立入库的知识片段”，每条片段要能单独检索、单独引用。

上周已经跑过一轮预处理，处理记录如下：

阶段A（已完成，结果已落盘）：
- 对全部原始HTML快照做了正文提取，去掉了标签，`<li>`/`<ol>` 转成了换行加星号的形式。落盘后正文字段里已经没有HTML标签了。
- 对提取后的正文做过一次Unicode修复与规范化，统一到NFC。

阶段B（本周新需求，要在阶段A的落盘结果上继续做）：
- 业务方希望“先按整篇文档的相关性排序，再决定哪些文档进入最终片段库”。相关性分数已经由上游检索团队算好，写在每条文档的一个数值字段里（字段名就叫 `relevance_score`，数值越大越相关）。
- 进入最终片段库的文档，需要按业务口径切分：以空行（连续两个换行）为优先切分点，单块最大字符数不超过800；如果某个自然段本身就超过800字符，允许强制切断，但相邻块之间要保留100字符的重叠，避免句子被切碎后语义丢失。
- 最终片段库只保留中文内容，且语言识别置信度不低于0.85。

样例数据（阶段A落盘后的两条记录，字段已简化展示）：

记录1：
- `relevance_score`: 0.93
- `text`: “安装说明\n\n本工具支持三种安装方式。第一种是通过包管理器直接安装，适合绝大多数用户。第二种是从源码编译安装，适合需要自定义编译选项的高级用户。第三种是离线安装包方式，适合内网环境。\n\n常见问题\n\n如果安装过程中提示缺少依赖，请先检查系统是否已安装对应的运行时。若仍失败，请查看日志目录下的 install.log。”
- 该记录在阶段A的统计缓存里已经带有 `text_len` 字段，值是阶段A当时正文的字符数；阶段A之后正文没有再改动过。

记录2：
- `relevance_score`: 0.71
- `text`: “API 概览\n\n本模块提供两类接口：查询类与写入类。查询类接口均为只读，不会修改服务端状态。写入类接口需要携带鉴权令牌。\n\n鉴权\n\n所有写入类接口都要求在请求头中携带 Bearer 令牌。令牌过期后需要重新申请。”
- 该记录在阶段A的统计缓存里没有 `text_len`，也没有任何语言相关字段。

补充说明：
- 阶段A落盘的数据里，正文已经是纯文本，不再含有HTML标签。
- 上游检索团队给的相关性分数只存在于整篇文档粒度上，切片之后不会再重新计算。
- 统计缓存是阶段A当时写入的，阶段A之后我们对正文没有做任何修改。
- 执行器不会自动删除或刷新任何已有的统计字段；如果某个统计字段在缓存里存在，算子会直接复用，不会重算。

请给出完成本周新需求所需的最小算子集合。

state:
Task: Select the minimal operator set for the current requirements; the execution order is arranged by the executor, and do not add unnecessary operators.
You are building RAG corpus for an enterprise public report retrieval library. The previous round of processing has already completed HTML tag stripping, Unicode garbled-text repair, and sentence-level deduplication within individual documents. The current batch of data has entered an intermediate state, and you need to select the minimal set of operators still required from a fixed candidate pool of 8 common operators to complete the remaining pipeline. The order is determined by the executor; this question only tests which operators are needed.

The current data fields include: text (body text), meta.source (source identifier), stats.lang (language), stats.lang_score (language confidence score), stats.text_len (character count), meta.quality_score (manual spot-check quality score).

The following are partial sample snippets used to demonstrate the current data form:
Sample A snippet: {"text": "本公司2023年度营业收入实现稳步增长...", "meta":{"source":"report_2023_A","quality_score":92}, "stats":{"lang":"zh","lang_score":0.95,"text_len":4500}}
Sample B snippet: {"text": "本公司2023年度营业收入实现稳步增长...", "meta":{"source":"report_2023_B_mirror","quality_score":88}, "stats":{"lang":"zh","lang_score":0.96,"text_len":4500}}
Sample C snippet: {"text": "Q1 revenue summary.", "meta":{"source":"en_snippet","quality_score":70}, "stats":{"lang":"en","lang_score":0.91,"text_len":19}}
Sample D snippet: {"text": "测试", "meta":{"source":"short_test","quality_score":10}, "stats":{"lang":"zh","lang_score":0.45,"text_len":2}}
Sample E snippet: {"text": "长达两万字的年报全文...", "meta":{"source":"annual_full","quality_score":95}, "stats":{"lang":"zh","lang_score":0.98,"text_len":21000}}
Note: The above text contents are only truncated snippet illustrations, but stats.text_len records the true character counts of the complete body text for each sample.

The business requirements are as follows:
1. Remove invalid entries that are too short or too long: The system requires that the character count of texts stored in the database must be between 50 and 10000 characters, in order to exclude meaningless fragments and overly long documents exceeding the context window. According to the true length statistics, Sample C (19 characters), Sample D (2 characters), and Sample E (21000 characters) should all not enter the final database. Since the earlier sentence-level deduplication operation may have changed the body text length, the executor will automatically clear the expired stats.text_len cache before running this step, ensuring recalculation and filtering based on the current true character count.
2. Ensure language purity and recognition reliability: The retrieval library serves only Chinese users, so records that are non-Chinese or have a recognition confidence score below 0.8 must be discarded entirely. For example, Sample C's language is English, and although Sample D is marked as Chinese, its confidence score is only 0.45; both should be filtered out. Since existing cached values cannot be directly relied upon (the languages of some newly merged data have not yet been re-scored), the executor will automatically remove the expired stats.lang and stats.lang_score fields before this step, forcing re-identification and scoring of the language on the current body text before making the judgment.
3. Eliminate completely identical cross-document duplicates: Although intra-sentence duplicates were cleared earlier, reports crawled from different channels may be entirely identical across whole documents. Comparing Sample A and Sample B, their text contents are completely identical, with only meta.source differing. It is necessary to retain exactly one unique copy based on exact matching of the body text content, to avoid returning multiple identical results during retrieval.
4. Adapt to fixed-length input for the vector database: Valid long texts that pass the above filtering may still exceed the single-processing limit of the Embedding model, so they must be split into multiple independent paragraphs according to a fixed maximum character count. When splitting, use character-level counting (without specifying any tokenizer) to ensure strict segmentation according to the character count limit.
5. Truncate top resources according to a specified metric: Constrained by storage budget, ultimately only the top 2000 segments with the highest meta.quality_score values after all the above cleaning and splitting need to be retained for index construction. The sorting basis must be the value of that specific nested field.

Please select from the fixed 210 option IDs the option ID corresponding to the minimal operator set that satisfies all the above requirements without containing any redundant steps. Operators that have already been completed cannot be selected again; if adding a certain operator makes no substantive contribution to satisfying the above 5 requirements, then the option containing that operator is not the minimal set.

Task: Select the minimal operator set for the current remaining requirements. The order within the set is arranged by the executor; only select the needed operators and do not add unnecessary steps. All questions use the same fixed operator set table. ## Task Background A city's public transportation group is building a passenger-oriented intelligent question-answering system. In the earlier phase, the team has crawled a large number of announcements, route adjustment notices, and riding guides from the official bus website. The raw data is stored in JSONL format, and each record contains two fields: `text` (body text) and `meta` (metadata). At present, the first-stage data cleaning work has been completed: the team has used external scripts to perform document-level exact-match deduplication on all samples (based on MD5 hash), and has fixed Unicode encoding issues for some garbled characters. These intermediate results have been saved as the input file for the current batch. Now entering the second-stage processing, you need to select the minimal combination of operators that still need to be executed (2 to 5 operators) from the given candidate operator set, according to the following business requirements. Note: the order is determined by the execution engine; this question only examines which operators are needed. ## Business Requirements and Current Data Status **Requirement 1: Strip web markup** Because the crawler directly scraped the web page source code, the current `text` field still contains a large amount of residual HTML tags and DOM structures, causing downstream models to be unable to read it correctly. For example, sampling found the following fragment: ```json {"text": "

关于302路临时改线的通知

因道路施工，自即日起302路取消停靠中山广场站。

", "meta": {"source": "web", "route_id": "302"}} ``` It must be converted to plain text form, preserving the readable content. **Requirement 2: Remove invalid-length samples** When analyzing the current batch, it was found that some samples have only a few characters left after HTML removal (such as residual navigation bar text like "Home" and "Contact Us"), while others are entire regulations spanning tens of thousands of characters. The business side requires keeping only samples whose total character count falls within a reasonable range (for example, no fewer than 20 characters and no more than 5000 characters); those that are too short or too long must be discarded. Note: no text length statistics fields have been computed in the current data yet, so the judgment must be based on the actual body text character count. **Requirement 3: Language purity control** Although this is a corpus from a domestic public transportation system, the crawler mistakenly captured some English-language travel guide pages and some blank placeholder pages composed purely of symbols. Sampling statistics show: - Sample A: "Route 101 has been suspended due to maintenance." (pure English) - Sample B: "！！！……？？？《》【】" (pure punctuation symbols) - Sample C: "因暴雨预警，今日所有轮渡航线停航。" (normal Chinese) We need to automatically identify the primary language of each text and keep only records that are determined to be Chinese and whose model confidence score reaches the threshold. No language or confidence statistics fields have been computed in the current data yet. **Requirement 4: Long text splitting** For longer announcements that pass the above filtering (such as comprehensive notices containing multiple route adjustments), in order to adapt to the context window limitations of the subsequent retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system, a single long text needs to be physically truncated and split according to a fixed maximum character count limit, generating multiple shorter independent text chunks. Here, splitting is required by character count, not by token count. **Requirement 5: Select and retain the best by quality score** During the first-stage processing, the team already called a pre-trained quality scoring model and wrote each record's score into the metadata field `meta.quality_score` (a float). The current batch contains approximately 5 ten-thousand records, but computing resources are limited, and ultimately only the top 10% of records with the highest values in this field need to be retained for fine-tuning. Please note that the sorting is based on this specific field in the metadata, not on some statistic of the text itself. ## Completed Work and Current Schema - **Completed**: Document-level exact deduplication (cross-document duplicates have been eliminated), Unicode encoding repair. - **Not yet completed**: The operations corresponding to the above 5 requirements have not been executed. - **Current data schema**: - `text`: string, the announcement body containing raw HTML. - `meta`: dict, containing `source` (string), `route_id` (string), `quality_score` (float). - **Intra-sentence duplication situation**: After manual spot-checking, there is no obvious sentence-level self-duplication within the current texts (such as "因施工停运因施工停运"), so no additional processing for intra-sentence redundancy is needed. ## Question Based on the above 5 unfinished business requirements and the progress of completed work, select a minimal and sufficient operator set. This set must exactly cover all unfinished requirements; it must not lack necessary steps, nor may it contain redundant steps that are ineffective for the current data state or were already completed in the first stage.

任务：从固定组合表选择满足当前数据处理需求的最小算子集合。只选必要算子；集合顺序由执行器安排。
背景：市交通信息中心把各线路的“服务调整公告”网页抓取后归档，交给数据工程做一份可检索的分块语料。业务方强调：他们最终要的是“按整篇公告的阅读热度排名靠前的那些公告，再切成适合检索的片段”，也就是说，排名对象必须是整篇公告，切片只是最后一步的形态转换，不能因为切片而把某些公告的入选资格改变。

阶段一（上周已完成，产物已落盘）：抓取到的原始记录里正文是网页 HTML 片段，工程同学先跑了一遍正文提取，把标签去掉、把列表项转成带项目符号的纯文本；随后又跑了一遍编码修复，把抓取时混入的乱码字符规整成正常中文。阶段一产物里每条记录保留字段：doc_id（公告编号）、url、publish_date、text（已提取并修复后的整篇公告正文）、read_count（该公告在门户的累计阅读量，整数）、source_site。阶段一没有做任何过滤、去重、切片或排名，也没有写入任何统计字段。

阶段二（本次要做）：输入就是阶段一的落盘产物。业务方的验收口径有三条，彼此牵连：
（1）只保留正文为中文、且中文识别置信度不低于 0.85 的公告；
（2）正文长度太短的公告属于抓取残缺，要剔除，业务方给出的下限是 80 个字符；
（3）最终交付的是分块语料，但“哪些公告能进入交付”必须完全等价于“按 read_count 从高到低取前 40 篇公告”。换句话说，如果先切片再排名，同一篇公告会被拆成多条、read_count 被复制多份，排名口径就被破坏了；如果先排名再切片，被选中的公告切片后条数会变多，这是允许的，业务方要的就是这 40 篇公告的全部片段。

样例（阶段一产物节选，用于说明字段形态）：
{"doc_id":"A-2201","url":".../notice/2201","publish_date":"2026-03-02","text":"受道路施工影响，自3月5日起，17路、23路临时调整走向……","read_count":9821,"source_site":"citybus"}
{"doc_id":"A-2202","url":".../notice/2202","publish_date":"2026-03-02","text":"因客流变化，自3月10日起，夜班N5路发车间隔由30分钟调整为20分钟……","read_count":15340,"source_site":"citybus"}
{"doc_id":"A-2203","url":".../notice/2203","publish_date":"2026-03-03","text":"站点更名通知：原‘人民广场东’站更名为‘人民广场东（地铁口）’……","read_count":77,"source_site":"metro"}

补充说明：阶段一产物里 text 已经是纯文本，不存在 HTML 标签；阶段一产物里也没有任何统计缓存字段（没有 text_len、没有 lang、没有 lang_score、没有 hash、没有 chunk_count）。执行器负责安排算子顺序，不会自动补算或删除任何统计字段；请只使用目录中已有的算子，不要引入需要人工判断的规则。

【工作说明：文档站变更增量入库】

背景：我们维护一个内部产品文档站，源站每晚导出变更页面为 JSONL，每行一个页面，字段包括 doc_id、url、raw_html、meta（含 lastmod、section）、以及上一阶段流水线写入的 stats。现在要把“变更页”入库到检索系统，要求正文干净、语言合规、长度合规，并按 chunk 粒度供下游向量库消费。

上游已完成（昨晚 23:40 的批次记录）：
- 阶段A：对 raw_html 执行过 HTML 正文提取，结果写入 text 字段；同时把 stats.text_len 计算好并随样本落盘。
- 阶段A 还对全量页面按 text 做过一次文档级精确去重（保留首次出现），去重时未开启 lowercase/ignore_non_character。
- 阶段A 未做语言识别，stats 中没有 lang/lang_score。

当前批次样例（节选，3 行）：
1) {"doc_id":"p101","url":"/a","raw_html":"<html>...","text":"产品使用指南\n\n安装步骤如下。安装步骤如下。\n\nFAQ","meta":{"section":"guide","lastmod":"2026-10-13"},"stats":{"text_len":42}}
2) {"doc_id":"p102","url":"/b","raw_html":"<html>...","text":"This page describes the API usage and examples.","meta":{"section":"api","lastmod":"2026-10-13"},"stats":{"text_len":45}}
3) {"doc_id":"p103","url":"/c","raw_html":"<html>...","text":"产品使用指南\n\n安装步骤如下。安装步骤如下。\n\nFAQ","meta":{"section":"guide","lastmod":"2026-10-13"},"stats":{"text_len":42}}

说明：p101 与 p103 是同一正文在不同 URL 的镜像页；阶段A 的去重是在“全量页面”上做的，但本次入库只处理“变更页子集”，子集内仍可能出现同源镜像同时变更的情况，需要在本子集内再去重一次，避免向量库重复。

入库要求（相互依赖，需同时满足）：
- 只保留中文页面，且语言识别置信度不低于 0.8；识别结果需写入 stats 供审计。
- 只保留正文字符长度在 [10, 2000] 的页面；注意 stats.text_len 是阶段A基于提取后 text 计算的，若本阶段对 text 做了任何改动，则该缓存不再可信，需以改动后的 text 重新计算长度再过滤。
- 下游向量库按 chunk 写入，chunk 大小 500 字符、按空行优先切分；每个 chunk 需携带原页面的 doc_id/url/meta 字段（由执行器负责字段复制）。
- 去重必须在“最终入库文本”的粒度上进行，且要在长度/语言过滤之后执行，避免被过滤掉的页面影响去重结果；同时去重应基于本阶段最终 text（含可能的清洗改动），而不是阶段A的旧 text。

可选优化（非必须）：若后续要做“按 section 取每个栏目最相关 TopK”，可再评估是否引入选择器；但当前入库不要求。

请给出：为完成本批次入库，仍需执行的最小算子集合（只能从给定 8 个算子中选），并说明为什么每个算子必要、为什么不需要其它算子。

Task: Select the minimal operator set for the current remaining requirements. The order within the set is arranged by the executor; select only the needed operators, and do not add unnecessary steps. All questions use the same fixed operator set table. ## Task Background You are preparing training data for a news summarization model. In the previous round of processing, the team has already completed cross-document exact deduplication (based on the MD5 hash of the entire text) and used a language identification model to filter out non-Chinese samples. A floating-point field named `quality_score` has already been written into the metadata of each sample; this field was computed by an external scoring script in the previous stage. In this round, you need to continue completing the remaining cleaning and filtering work, and finally deliver a batch of high-quality plain-text corpus. ## Business Requirements 1. **Strip web markup**: The originally collected news body text is still wrapped in HTML tags (such as `

`, `

`, `
  • `, etc.) and needs to be converted into clean plain text; list items should be converted into a bulleted format. 2. **Eliminate sentence-level redundancy within a single article**: Due to crawler parsing issues or editorial mistakes, some articles contain completely identical sentences that are repeatedly output multiple times. Within a single sample, repeated sentences must be retained only once. 3. **Remove overly short fragments**: After the first two processing steps, some samples may be left with extremely short characters (for example, only a few characters of title residue remain). It is required to discard samples whose total character count is less than 50 characters, but no upper limit is imposed. Note: Because the first two steps modify the body content, the executor must, after each mapping operation that affects the body text, first remove outdated statistical fields (such as `stats.text_len`) before running the length filter, to ensure that the character count is recalculated based on the current latest text. 4. **Extract top data by quality score**: Finally, only the top 1000 samples with the highest values in the `quality_score` field need to be retained for fine-tuning. ## Data Schema ```json { "text": "string, 新闻正文内容", "meta": { "quality_score": "float, 上一轮外部脚本写入的质量评分", "source_url": "string, 来源链接" }, "stats": { "lang": "string, 上一轮已计算并过滤，当前均为zh", "lang_score": "float, 上一轮已计算", "hash": "string, 上一轮文档级去重已使用的MD5值" } } ``` ## Actual Data Fragment Examples **Sample A** - `text`: `

    今日股市迎来大幅上涨。今日股市迎来大幅上涨。投资者信心显著增强。

    • 科技板块领涨
    • 消费板块紧随其后
    ` - `meta.quality_score`: 0.92 - `stats.text_len`: Not calculated **Sample B** - `text`: `

    本报讯

    ` - `meta.quality_score`: 0.85 - `stats.text_len`: Not calculated **Sample C** - `text`: `这是一篇关于气候变化的深度报道。全球气温持续上升，极端天气事件频发。这是一篇关于气候变化的深度报道。各国政府正在制定新的减排政策以应对这一挑战。` - `meta.quality_score`: 0.78 - `stats.text_len`: Not calculated ## Existing Work and Intermediate State - Completed: Cross-document exact match deduplication (based on `stats.hash`). - Completed: Language identification and filtering (retaining Chinese only). - Completed: External model scoring each sample and writing it into `meta.quality_score`. - Not yet completed: HTML tag stripping, intra-document sentence-level deduplication, character-count-based length truncation, specified-field-based TopK filtering. The candidate set has been pre-generated with a fixed 210 options, each option containing a different combination of the above 8 operators. Based on the above business requirements and data status, select the minimal set that exactly satisfies all requirements of this round without containing any redundant operators. Note: This question does not test the operator execution order; it only tests the minimal completeness of the set.

任务：从固定配方表中选择满足当前数据处理需求的最小配方；如目录内没有能满足全部需求的配方，选择NO_VALID_RECIPE。执行器只安排顺序和源码已有参数，不额外提供未声明的分组、字段改写、缓存失效或外部参考集合能力。 任务：从固定组合表选择满足当前数据处理需求的最小算子集合。只选必要算子；集合顺序由执行器安排。 【工作说明：论文附录与实验记录语料统一交付】 背景：我们组维护一个内部语料库，素材来自论文附录抓取页和实验记录导出。现在要把两批历史处理进度不一致的数据统一成同一份可交付格式，交给下游检索组。请只在平台已注册的 8 个算子内选择，执行器会自行安排顺序，不要加无必要步骤。 素材与现状： 批次A（论文附录，doc 级，3 条样例）： - A1: text 为 HTML："

Ablation study on tokenizer.

  1. Setup A
  2. Setup B

See appendix for details.

"，meta.source="appendix"，stats 为空。 - A2: text 已是纯文本："Ablation study on tokenizer. Setup A. Setup B. See appendix for details."，stats 为空。 - A3: text 为 HTML："

Ablation study on tokenizer.

  1. Setup A
  2. Setup B

See appendix for details.

"（与 A1 完全相同的抓取副本），stats 为空。 批次B（实验记录，doc 级，2 条样例）： - B1: text 为纯文本："Training curve is stable. Training curve is stable. Final loss 0.42."，stats 中已有 text_len=62（该值是上周对同一份未改动文本算出的，之后文本未再被任何步骤修改）。 - B2: text 为纯文本："Data pipeline note. Data pipeline note. Data pipeline note. Done."，stats 中已有 text_len=58，同样是在文本未改动时算出的。 交付要求（三条必须同时满足，且相互牵制）： 1) 最终输出必须是 chunk 级记录：每条样本的 text 为按空行切分后、每块不超过 120 字符的块；下游按 chunk 建索引，不再接受整文。注意：批次A 的 HTML 必须先转成纯文本再切块，否则标签会污染 chunk 内容；切块本身不会生成 chunk_count 字段，不要指望它。 2) 最终只保留语言识别为英文且置信分不低于 0.8 的 chunk。语言判定必须基于清洗、切块后的实际文本，不能沿用任何 doc 级旧结论（批次B 的 stats 里目前没有 lang/lang_score）。 3) 在切块之前，必须先去掉 doc 级完全重复的样本（A1 与 A3 是同一篇附录的两次抓取，只能保留一份），避免同一内容在 chunk 级出现两次。 补充约束：批次B 的 text_len 缓存是在文本未被修改时算出的，如果某条处理路径会改动文本，则该缓存对新文本不再有效；但语言过滤所需的 lang/lang_score 目前不存在，必须新算。不要为凑步骤数而加入对交付目标无影响的算子。

## Task Background

A city's public transportation data governance team is building a bus announcement corpus for training large language models. The preliminary work has completed two phases: the first phase exported raw text from the dispatch systems of various routes; the second phase had annotators manually assign quality scores to each announcement (0-100 points), and wrote the scoring results into the `meta.quality_score` field of each sample.

The team is now entering the third phase and needs to complete the remaining cleaning and filtering work in this round of the pipeline. The following are all the business requirements that must be satisfied in this round and the corresponding actual data status.

## Business Requirements

**Requirement one: Remove invalid announcements that are too short or too long.**
The dispatch system occasionally writes placeholders consisting of only a few characters, or produces excessively long garbled text due to interface anomalies. The team requires retaining only announcements whose character count is between 20 and 500. Note: what is counted here is the total character count of the entire announcement, not the lengths counted separately after splitting it into small segments.

**Requirement two: Eliminate completely identical duplicate entries across different batches.**
Because multiple routes share the same template and exports were performed multiple times on different dates, the dataset contains a large number of duplicate records whose entire content is exactly identical. The team requires exact-match deduplication at the document level, retaining only the first occurrence of each record. This differs from the case where sentences within a single announcement repeat themselves; the focus here is on complete identity at the cross-document level.

**Requirement three: Truncate to top samples based on existing quality scores.**
The annotators have already stored the manual scores in the `meta.quality_score` field in the earlier phase. This round does not require calling a model again for scoring; instead, directly sort from high to low based on the values in this field, and retain only the top 1000 announcements for subsequent experiments.

## Actual Data Snippet and Schema

The following is a JSONL-format snippet of some samples from the current batch (desensitized, all fictional):

```json
{"text": "因道路施工，301路临时绕行。", "meta": {"quality_score": 85, "line_id": "301"}}
{"text": "通知：停运。", "meta": {"quality_score": 40, "line_id": "12"}}
{"text": "因道路施工，301路临时绕行。", "meta": {"quality_score": 85, "line_id": "301"}}
{"text": "接上级部门紧急通知，受强台风影响，全市所有公交线路自即刻起全面暂停运营，恢复时间另行通知，请广大市民提前做好出行规划并注意安全。接上级部门紧急通知，受强台风影响...（此处省略至总计620个字符）", "meta": {"quality_score": 92, "line_id": "ALL"}}
{"text": "地铁2号线延长运营至次日凌晨1点。", "meta": {"quality_score": 78, "line_id": "M2"}}
```

**Field Schema Description:**
- `text`: string, the plain text body of the announcement, without HTML tags.
- `meta.quality_score`: float, the manual score from the earlier phase, range 0-100.
- `meta.line_id`: string, the route identifier.

**Batch Statistics:**
- Total sample size: 15000 records.
- Character count distribution: approximately 8% of samples have fewer than 20 characters, and approximately 3% of samples have more than 500 characters.
- Cross-document duplication rate: approximately 15% of samples have a `text` field that is completely identical to that of other samples.
- Encoding status: all are valid UTF-8 Chinese characters and punctuation, with no garbled text.
- Format status: plain text, with no residual HTML tags.

## Existing Work and Intermediate State

1. HTML stripping and Unicode repair have already been completed in the previous version; the current `text` field is already clean plain text, and there is no need to perform the related conversions again.
2. The manual quality scores have already been written into `meta.quality_score`; this round does not require using any filter based on language identification confidence to replace or re-evaluate quality.
3. The team explicitly requires that this round not perform physical truncation or chunking operations on long texts, because downstream tasks need the complete announcement context, and chunking would destroy semantic coherence.

## Optional Operator Set (8 in total, fixed and unmodifiable)

A. clean_html_mapper
B. fix_unicode_mapper
C. remove_repeat_sentences_mapper
D. text_length_filter
E. language_id_score_filter
F. document_deduplicator
G. text_chunk_mapper
H. topk_specified_field_selector
